hero.subtitle: Supplying businesses across Portugal with premium-quality fruits and vegetables sourced directly from our farms and trusted agricultural partners in Spain. Every day, freshness, quality, and competitive wholesale pricing.

about.paragraph1: MARL is King Internationals' dedicated wholesale fresh produce division, created to provide businesses with reliable access to high-quality fruits and vegetables in bulk quantities.
about.paragraph2: By combining produce grown on our own farms with carefully selected imports from Spain, we ensure a consistent supply of fresh products throughout the year. Our commitment to quality, efficiency, and dependable service makes MARL a trusted sourcing destination for businesses of every size.

items.question: Who can purchase from MARL?
items.answer: MARL Wholesale serves supermarkets, restaurants, catering companies, hotels, food distributors, and independent retailers requiring produce in wholesale quantities.

items.question: Where is the produce sourced?
items.answer: Our produce is sourced directly from King Internationals' own agricultural farms as well as carefully selected agricultural partners in Spain.

items.question: Is fresh produce available every day?
items.answer: Yes, we receive daily fresh deliveries to ensure continuous product availability and maximum shelf life for all our wholesale clients.

items.question: Do you stock seasonal produce?
items.answer: Yes, our inventory evolves throughout the year to reflect peak seasonal harvests alongside essential year-round staples.

items.question: What types of products are available?
items.answer: We offer a complete range of fresh vegetables, leafy greens, orchard fruits, citrus, berries, and seasonal regional produce.
